A new shipment of raw materials arrives. You're already in place with the forklift, checking the delivery note and making sure everything is stored correctly. Not much later, you're helping pick and prepare a large order, scan, stack, seal, and ready for shipment. Thanks to your focus and efficiency, the logistics flow at Elho runs like clockwork.
